Description

A lively forge where the ring of hammer on steel never stops. Weapons of all kinds line the walls — some mundane, some faintly glowing with enchantment.

Proprietor

Bruna Hammerstrike — boisterous and jovial, passionate about beautiful and deadly weapons

Services & Wares

  • Common and uncommon weapons
  • Some magical weapons on display
  • Custom weapon commissions
  • Weapon repairs and sharpening

Reputation

Popular with the village guard and passing adventurers. Bruna's enthusiasm is infectious.
